target_moa.text: Oliceridine is a full opioid agonist relatively selective for the mu-opioid receptor; it is a G protein-biased ligand that binds the mu-opioid receptor and stimulates G protein-coupling with reduced beta-arrestin 2 recruitment. Its principal therapeutic action is analgesia.

Serious risks include life-threatening respiratory depression and QT prolongation with daily doses exceeding 27 mg.

summary.text: Oliceridine was a 505(b)(1) new molecular entity with Fast Track designation (granted December 2, 2015). Two breakthrough therapy designation requests were denied, and priority review was not granted (standard review). The original NDA (submitted November 2, 2017) received a Complete Response on November 2, 2018 following an October 2018 Advisory Committee meeting; the applicant resubmitted on February 7, 2020, leading to approval, with deferred pediatric studies required under PREA.
